author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
A giant meat pie, glowing hot stones, and the warmth of an open fire — this is authentic village cooking at its finest 🔥🥩 In this video, we prepare a traditional meat pie baked beneath hot river stones, using an old-fashioned method that has been passed down through generations.

The pie slowly cooks under the heated stones, creating a beautifully golden crust while sealing in the rich, juicy meat filling. The gentle, even heat gives every bite a deep, rustic flavor and a texture that's both crisp on the outside and tender inside.

This is true countryside baking — simple ingredients, natural heat, and timeless tradition. Cooking with hot stones is one of the oldest village techniques, transforming a homemade meat pie into a hearty feast full of authentic flavor and rustic charm. 🔥🍞🌿
title: Hot Stones Meat Pie – Authentic Village Cooking 🔥🥩
